title: Telnet allowed on VTY lines
description: Telnet sends passwords and sessions in clear text.
remediation: Under 'line vty 0 15' set 'transport input ssh'.

title: Plain HTTP management server enabled
description: The HTTP server is unencrypted and has been the entry point for several critical IOS XE attacks.
remediation: Run 'no ip http server'. If the web UI is needed, use 'ip http secure-server' restricted by an ACL.

title: Default SNMP community string
description: 'public' and 'private' are the first values attackers try.
remediation: Remove the default community and move to SNMPv3 (authPriv).

title: SNMP read-write community configured
description: Anyone with the string can change the configuration.
remediation: Remove RW communities; use SNMPv3 with read-only views for monitoring.

title: 'enable password' used instead of 'enable secret'
description: The enable password is stored with weak, reversible encoding.
remediation: Replace with 'enable secret' (type 8 or 9) and remove 'enable password'.

title: Password encryption service disabled
description: Passwords appear in clear text in the configuration.
remediation: Run 'service password-encryption' (and prefer type 8/9 secrets).

title: No remote syslog server
description: Without remote logs, an attacker can erase evidence on the device.
remediation: Configure 'logging host <syslog-server>'.

title: No NTP server configured
remediation: Configure 'ntp server <server>' so log timestamps are reliable.

title: SSH version 1 enabled
remediation: Run 'ip ssh version 2'.

title: No login banner
remediation: Add a 'banner login' with an authorised-use warning.

title: Telnet management enabled
description: Telnet sends passwords in clear text.
remediation: Remove 'telnet' lines and manage with SSH only.

title: ASDM/HTTPS management open to any address
remediation: Restrict 'http <network> <mask> <interface>' to the management network.

title: SSH management open to any address
remediation: Restrict 'ssh <network> <mask> <interface>' to the management network.

title: Default SNMP community string
remediation: Remove the default community and use SNMPv3.

title: Firewall rule permits any to any
description: A permit-any rule removes the protection the firewall should give.
remediation: Replace the rule with specific sources, destinations and services.

title: No remote syslog server
remediation: Configure 'logging host <interface> <server>'.

title: No NTP server configured
remediation: Configure 'ntp server <server>'.

title: Telnet server enabled
description: Telnet sends passwords in clear text.
remediation: Run 'undo telnet server enable' and use SSH ('ssh server enable').

title: Plain HTTP management enabled
remediation: Run 'undo ip http enable'; use 'ip https enable' restricted by an ACL if the web UI is needed.

title: Default SNMP community string
remediation: Remove the default community ('undo snmp-agent community ...') and use SNMPv3.

title: SNMPv1/v2c enabled
description: SNMPv1/v2c sends community strings in clear text.
remediation: Run 'snmp-agent sys-info version v3' and 'undo snmp-agent sys-info version v1 v2c'.

title: Local password stored in plain text
remediation: Re-set the password with 'password hash' (Comware 7) or 'password cipher' (Comware 5).

title: VTY or console line has no authentication
remediation: Set 'authentication-mode scheme' on all user-interface / line vty entries.

title: No remote syslog server
remediation: Configure 'info-center loghost <server>'.

title: No NTP server configured
remediation: Configure 'ntp-service unicast-server <server>'.

title: No login banner
remediation: Add 'header login' with an authorised-use warning.

title: Telnet management enabled
description: Telnet sends passwords in clear text.
remediation: Run 'no telnet cli' and manage the controller over SSH.

title: Default SNMP community string
remediation: Remove the default community and use SNMPv3.

title: No remote syslog server
remediation: Configure 'logging <server>'.

title: No NTP server configured
remediation: Configure 'ntp server <server>'.

title: Telnet server enabled (default)
description: ArubaOS-Switch enables Telnet unless it is turned off.
remediation: Run 'no telnet-server' and manage the switch over SSH.

title: Plain HTTP web management enabled (default)
remediation: Run 'no web-management plaintext' (keep 'web-management ssl' if the GUI is needed).

title: Default SNMP community string
remediation: Remove it ('no snmp-server community public') and use SNMPv3.

title: No remote syslog server
remediation: Configure 'logging <server>'.

title: No time server configured
remediation: Configure 'sntp server' or 'ntp server'.

title: Default SNMP community string
remediation: Remove the default community and use SNMPv3.

title: No remote syslog server
remediation: Configure 'logging <server>'.

title: No NTP server configured
remediation: Configure 'ntp server <server>'.

title: Web management enabled on the default (data) VRF
remediation: Prefer 'https-server vrf mgmt' so the web UI is only reachable from the management network.
